description: The first releasable product flavor: a self-contained, offline-only PvE Vanilla 1.12 realm on Android. This manifest is the contract the build, manifest merger, and release-acceptance checks enforce.

target_device_profile.development_abi: x86_64 on fixed G0-G3 AVD lanes

game.client_version: 1.12.1 build 5875 (user-supplied; PE/build fast scan in O07 and full managed import in O11)
game.notes: supported_client_builds is populated by O07/O11 once exact hashes are qualified. Empty means not yet qualified; import must reject until at least one entry exists.

includes.android_app: Kotlin/Compose launcher, supervisor, wizard, foreground service, controller bridge
includes.native_realm: Supervised native MariaDB, realmd, mangosd, and Playerbots components; x86_64 development then arm64-v8a parity (O08-O16)
includes.persistence: App-private MariaDB datadir/socket, migration ledger, dirty recovery, and database-consistent verified backups (O08-O12)
includes.client_import: Build-5875 validation plus resumable managed copy and checkpointed DBC/maps/vmaps/mmaps preparation (O07/O11)
includes.runtime_provider: x86DirectWine first; ARM-B Box64/Wine WoW64 after integrated x86; alternative runtimes are outside the release critical path (O06/O16-O17)
includes.addons: Minimal project-owned controller/status/bot UI plus curated reversible profiles (O14/O18)

excludes_from_release_artifact.proprietary_client_files: WoW.exe, MPQs, DBCs, maps, models, textures â€” never bundled; user imports them
excludes_from_release_artifact.connected_code: No connected transport, Realm Kernel, replication, or membership code in the offline APK
excludes_from_release_artifact.connected_permissions: No INTERNET-dependent authority, P2P, or relay permissions
excludes_from_release_artifact.hidden_online_switch: No runtime flag re-enables connected behavior

android_permissions.foreground_service_type: specialUse (long-running local realm server; dataSync is capped at 6h on Android 15 and unsuitable for multi-hour play)
android_permissions.storage: Scoped storage / SAF for client import and exports only
android_permissions.network_policy: INTERNET permits app-local TCP sockets and optional explicitly configured update checks; offline play binds realm endpoints to 127.0.0.1 and has no external authority dependency.

rule: The offline flavor is a hard boundary. Connected work (C-series) starts only after O22 is done and lives in a separate flavor/build type.
